visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a series of handheld tracking shots of a matte green BMW F750GS motorcycle parked on a grey tiled outdoor pavement. The motorcycle is equipped with black and brown textile luggage bags and protective crash bars. A glass-fronted building with interior showroom displays is visible in the background under natural daylight. Only the hand of the person filming is briefly seen reaching toward the bike. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a spacious, modern motorcycle dealership. The camera travels through a lounge area with tall grey stools and a wooden cafe bar, then into a showroom where several motorcycle models, including a black cafe racer and a red sportbike, are displayed on a polished wooden floor. The environment features dark industrial ceilings and bright studio lighting. (3) The camera focuses on a close-up, steady view of a printed service invoice held by a hand. A finger points to various line items, numbers, and price totals on the white paper. The lighting is uniform and bright indoor light. The video concludes with the hand providing a thumbs-up gesture over the document.
